kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أرتكن (form VIII)
# أَرْتَكِنُ (ʔartakinu) /ʔar.ta.ki.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَنَ (irtakana)
# أَرْتَكِنَ (ʔartakina) /ʔar.ta.ki.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَكَنَ (irtakana)
# أَرْتَكِنْ (ʔartakin) /ʔar.ta.kin/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَكَنَ (irtakana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
